title: A Promise for the Garden
author: Astrid Halloran
blurb: Yara Winterbourne, a marine biologist counting turtles instead of heartbreaks, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. Then a snowstorm strands two rivals with the best mistake of their twenties — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must forgive the person in the mirror first before the last ferry of the season departs.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
